info.title: Fathershops Front APIs
info.description:
# Fathershops Storefront API

The customer-facing API behind the storefront, account area, cart and checkout. One endpoint serves every store.

## Base URL

```
https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/
```

Set as the `host_name` variable. Keep the trailing slash — every request appends a relative path.

## X-Tenant — required on every request

The endpoint is shared, so the request must name the store. Core rewrites `HTTP_HOST` from `X-Tenant` before resolving the tenant database.

| store | X-Tenant |
|---|---|
| platform subdomain `login1.myfathershops.com` | `login1` — the bare label |
| merchant custom domain `zaroxii.com` | `zaroxii.com` — the full host |

> **Omitting it does not produce an error.** Core cannot resolve a store, so it serves the `store_not_found` HTML page with **HTTP 200** — a request that looks successful and returns no data. If a call returns HTML, check this header first.

## Authentication

Bearer JWT, set collection-wide from `{{access_token}}`. Guests are first-class: catalog, cart and checkout all work without a token.

Core stamps `customer_id` into whichever session the request runs on, so send `x-session-id` alongside the token to keep the signed-in state and the cart on one session.

## Headers

| header | required | description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Tenant` | **always** | Names the store. See above. |
| `x-platform` | yes | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| `x-session-id` | cart & checkout | Pins the call to a session, and therefore a cart. Core reads it BEFORE the `OCSESSID` cookie. |
| `Authorization` | signed-in only | `Bearer {{access_token}}`. |
| `x-domain` | optional | The store's own host. Sent by the frontend; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

## Quick start

1. Set `host_name` and `x-tenant`.
2. `GET common/common` → copy `data.session_id` into the `session_id` variable.
3. `POST checkout/cart/add` with a `product_id`.
4. `GET checkout/cart` → your line appears.
5. `GET checkout/init` → `data.checkout_id` and the shipping/payment options.

## Response format

Every JSON endpoint uses one envelope:

```json
{ "data": { }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

- `data` — the payload. `null` or `[]` when there is nothing to return.
- `errors` — validation problems, usually keyed by field name.
- `code` — mirrors the HTTP status.

## Error handling

The API answers **HTTP 200 for most application-level failures** and reports the problem inside the envelope. Branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code.

| symptom | cause |
|---|---|
| HTML instead of JSON | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown |
| `data: null` on a valid route | wrong URL form — use the path form, not `index.php?route=` |
| empty cart on every call | no `x-session-id`, so each call gets a fresh session |
| `{ "error": "Cart is empty" }` | expected on an empty cart, not a fault |

## Platforms

The routes are identical on **fathershops** and **sociify** — the checkout package contains no platform branching. Only the context differs:

| | fathershops | sociify |
|---|---|---|
| `x-platform` | `fathershops` | `sociify` |
| `X-Tenant` | required | required |
| `host_name` | `https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/` | its own API base |
| checkout served at | `/checkoutV2` | site root |

## Variables

| variable | purpose |
|---|---|
| `host_name` | API base URL (trailing slash). |
| `store_url` | The **storefront** host. Used only by *Open Shared Cart Link*, a page navigation rather than an API call. |
| `x-tenant` | Store identifier — required on every request. |
| `x-platform` | `fathershops` / `sociify`. |
| `session_id` | Core session; pins calls to a cart. |
| `access_token` | Bearer JWT for signed-in calls. |
| `checkout_id`, `checkout_token`, `cart_key`, `product_id`, `order_id`, `coupon`, `country_id`, `locale` | populated as you work through the flows. |

post.description:
Every currency configured on the store, with symbols and decimal settings.

```http
GET /api/common/currency
```

## Authentication

None. Works for guests.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

_No path, query or body parameters._

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/common/currency' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>'
```

get.description:
Bootstrap payload for the storefront: store identity, logo, languages, currencies, active locale — and the **session id** every other call pins itself to.

```http
GET /api/common/common
```

## Authentication

None. Works for guests.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| Content-Type | string | **yes** | `application/json`. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

_No path, query or body parameters._

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

Key fields: `session_id`, `name`, `logo`, `logo_src`, `languages`, `currencies`, `currency`, `language`.

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/common/common' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>'
```

## Notes

- **Call this first.** `data.session_id` is what you pass as `x-session-id` on cart and checkout calls.
- A client that skips it races itself — parallel calls with no session each cause core to mint a *different* session (MUL-3033).

get.description:
Category tree for this store.

```http
GET /api/product/category
```

## Authentication

None. Works for guests.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| Content-Type | string | **yes** | `application/json`. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

### Query parameters

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `parent_id` | integer | no | Return children of this category only. |

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/product/category' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' \
  -d '// { // "limit" : 1, // "page": 2 // }'
```

parameters.name: X-Tenant
parameters.description: **Required on every request.** Names the store. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the FULL host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. Without it core cannot resolve a store and returns the `store_not_found` HTML page with **HTTP 200** — a request that looks successful and carries no data.

parameters.name: x-platform
parameters.description: **Required.** `fathershops` or `sociify`.

parameters.name: x-session-id
parameters.description: Core session id. Read BEFORE the `OCSESSID` cookie, so this is what pins a call to a specific session and therefore a specific cart. Get one from `common/common` → `data.session_id`.

parameters.name: x-domain
parameters.description: _Optional._ The store's own public host. The frontend fetcher sends it as its own store identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not from this. Disabled by default.

get.description:
Platform-wide category tree.

```http
GET /api/product/platform/category
```

## Authentication

None. Works for guests.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| Content-Type | string | **yes** | `application/json`. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

_No path, query or body parameters._

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/product/platform/category' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' \
  -d '// { // "limit" : 1, // "page": 2 // } '
```

parameters.name: X-Tenant
parameters.description: **Required on every request.** Names the store. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the FULL host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. Without it core cannot resolve a store and returns the `store_not_found` HTML page with **HTTP 200** — a request that looks successful and carries no data.

get.description:
The session's current cart: line items, options, quantities, formatted prices and totals.

```http
GET /api/checkout/cart
```

## Authentication

Optional — guest carts and guest checkout are supported. Send a Bearer token for a signed-in shopper.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| x-session-id | string | **yes** | Core session id — identifies the cart. Read before the `OCSESSID` cookie. Get one from `common/common` → `data.session_id`. |
| Authorization | string | no | `Bearer <access_token>` for a signed-in shopper. Guests may omit it. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

_No path, query or body parameters._

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

`data.products[]`, `data.totals[]`, `data.weight`, `data.total_saving`.

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/checkout/cart' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'x-session-id: <x_session_id>'
```

## Notes

- `x-session-id` selects **which** cart — this is the call the enhanced cart page makes on load.
- An empty cart returns `text_error: "Your shopping cart is empty!"` and no `products` array. Not an error.
- ⚠ The JSON branch strips `error_warning` and never builds the coupon / voucher / reward / shipping-estimate panels, so **out-of-stock and minimum-quantity warnings are absent** even when core has them.

### Headers

JSON object.

| field | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/checkout/cart/add' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'x-session-id: <x_session_id>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' \
  -d '{ "product_id": "{{product_id}}", "quantity": 1, "option": {} }'
```

get.description:
The redeem hop — a real **browser navigation**, not an API call. Seeds the visitor's own session with the coded cart and redirects onward.

```http
GET /c/{{checkout_token}}
```

**Base URL is `{{store_url}}` (the storefront), not `{{host_name}}`.** This hop sets the visitor's session cookie, which the API host does not serve.

## Authentication

None.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

### Path parameters

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | **yes** | 64-hex code from **Get Checkout Token**. |

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `302 Found` | Cart seeded. `Location` points at the store checkout, `Set-Cookie: OCSESSID` carries the new session, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` is set. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

Redirect-following is turned **off** on this request so the headers are visible.

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://login1.myfathershops.com/c/{{checkout_token}}' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>'
```

## Notes

- **Why not `?session_id=` in the URL:** a session id in a link is a session-fixation and session-theft vector — it leaks via `Referer`, browser history and CDN logs, and anyone replaying it becomes that shopper. This transfers a short-lived, unguessable, store-bound reference to the **cart** and lets the visitor keep their own session, so there is no session to hijack.
- Verified live:
```
GET /api/checkout/getToken   x-session-id: A  -> token 788ee257…
GET /c/788ee257…            (no session)     -> 302
    Set-Cookie: OCSESSID=38cdd1cf…              <- a NEW, DIFFERENT session
    Location: /checkout
GET /api/checkout/cart       x-session-id: B  -> the same product
```
Session A is never exposed to the browser; the visitor gets session B holding a **copy** of the cart.

get.description:
The checkout bootstrap — cart, totals, saved addresses, shipping and payment method lists, and the store identity policy, in one payload.

```http
GET /api/checkout/init?checkout_token={{checkout_token}}
```

## Authentication

Optional — guest carts and guest checkout are supported. Send a Bearer token for a signed-in shopper.

## Parameters

### Headers

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| X-Tenant | string | **yes** | Names the store on the shared endpoint. Bare label (`login1`) for a platform subdomain, or the full host (`zaroxii.com`) for a merchant custom domain. **Required on every request** — see the note below. |
| x-platform | string | **yes** | `fathershops` or `sociify`. |
| x-session-id | string | **yes** | Core session id — identifies the cart. Read before the `OCSESSID` cookie. Get one from `common/common` → `data.session_id`. |
| Authorization | string | no | `Bearer <access_token>` for a signed-in shopper. Guests may omit it. |
| x-domain | string | no | The store's own public host. Sent by the frontend as its own identifier; core resolves the store from `X-Tenant`, not this. |

> ⚠ **`X-Tenant` is required on every request.** Omitting it is not an error: core cannot resolve a store, so it returns the `store_not_found` **HTML** page with **HTTP 200**. If a call returns HTML instead of JSON, check this header first.

### Query parameters

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkout_token` | string | no | A shared-cart code. Seeds the cart from it **before** building the payload. |

## Response

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `200 OK` | Success. Payload in `data`. **Also returned for most application-level failures** — branch on `errors` / `data.error`, not on the status code. |
| `200 OK` (HTML body) | `X-Tenant` missing or unknown — the store could not be resolved. |

Envelope:

```json
{ "data": { … }, "errors": [], "code": 200 }
```

Key fields: `checkout_id`, `checkout_data`, `login_style`, `guest_checkout`, `guest_optin`, `city_autocomplete`.

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api-front.myfathershops.com/api/checkout/init?checkout_token={{checkout_token}}' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
  -H 'x-session-id: <x_session_id>'
```

## Notes

- ⚠ **Omit `checkout_token` entirely when there is none.** Core tests it for truthiness, so the literal string `"null"` counts as a real token and sends it hunting a snapshot that never existed (MUL-2826).
- **No `checkout_id` in the response means there is no checkout session** (usually an empty cart). That missing key — not a flag — is what the apps branch on.
- `redirect: "cart"` means core wants the shopper sent back to the cart.

| status | meaning |

```bash
  -H 'X-Tenant: <x_tenant>' \
  -H 'x-platform: <x_platform>' \
```

JSON object.

| field | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_data` | object | **yes** | Final checkout state, as for Save. |
| `agree` | boolean | conditional | Required when a checkout terms page is configured. |
| `privacy` | boolean | conditional | Required when a separate privacy page is configured. |
| `captchaToken` | string | conditional | Required when a captcha provider is enabled. |


On success, the encrypted order id and the next step for the payment gateway.

## Errors

| condition | response |
|---|---|
| missing address field | `payment_city`, `shipping_country`, … keyed `<type>_<field>` |
| no method chosen | `payment_code` / `shipping_code` |
| required custom field empty | `<type>_custom_field`, keyed by `custom_field_id` |

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' \
  -d '{ "order_data": {}, "agree": true, "privacy": true }'
```

## Notes

- ⚠ Validation runs for **both** checkouts and can reject things the enhanced UI does not render — required **custom fields** and a **required comment**. A store using either cannot complete an order on the enhanced checkout.
